unmutated.check_build_output: Its subject is the absence of a thing: no build output is tracked, and every package root ignores its own. A mutation would have to *add* a tracked artifact, which `scripts/mutate.py` cannot express -- its patches replace text in one file, and this needs a new file plus a .gitignore edit. Its fixture tests cover the rules over a tree they build.
unmutated.check_build_stamp: Deferred. The stamp is generated at build time from the Cargo manifests, so the honest mutation is to a manifest and the guard's answer depends on a rebuild -- which does not fit on this container's disk beside a mutation run. See the disk note in CLAUDE.md.
unmutated.check_caveat_citations: Deferred. Its input is docs/caveat-status.json, which every entry in this session edits; a mutation run against it races any concurrent triage and the restore would fight it.
unmutated.check_closed_caveats: Deferred. Its witnesses are needles in test files, so the mutation is a rename in a file another guard's suite already mutates -- and two suites mutating one file cannot run at once safely.
unmutated.check_demo_surface: Deferred. Its roster is the demo's adapter endpoints against the UI that calls them, and the UI is TypeScript the guard reads as text; a mutation is cheap but the surface moved twice this month and the anchor would rot faster than the suite is worth.
unmutated.check_examples_roster: Deferred. Its subject is scripts/run_examples.sh's floors and handshake roster, which are also what scripts/test_check_examples_roster.py builds fixtures for; picking an anchor that is not also in that fixture needs a read this session did not do.
unmutated.check_mutation_claims: Deferred. Its input is ledger entries' mutation counts, and a mutation to one would be a deliberate falsehood written into the ledger for the length of a run. It has been exercised for real twice this session, refusing a count this session got wrong.
unmutated.check_site_claims: Deferred. It reads four trees and its claims are counts derived from them, so a one-line anchor that is a real claim rather than incidental prose needs a read this session did not do.
